s00-01-story-d35f4f.wav.text: Every nativity set has three kings kneeling at the manger.

s00-02-pivot-dd7eb1.wav.text: But Matthew never says there were three.

s00-03-story-d02066.wav.text: He never calls them kings. And they never saw the manger.

s01-01-story-f531b3.wav.text: Wise men from the east saw a star rise.

s01-02-story-3939d1.wav.text: They crossed hundreds of miles of desert to Jerusalem, and asked a dangerous question.
